title: AWS Generative AI Developer - Professional
description: A practical preparation path for production-oriented generative AI development on AWS.

sources.title: AWS Certified Generative AI Developer - Professional Exam Guide

lessons.title: Model output is untrusted input
lessons.summary: Separate parsing, validation, safety, and authority boundaries.

blocks.body: A successful model call does not produce trusted application data. Parse output, validate its schema, apply safety policy, and keep authorization deterministic.

blocks.title: Never delegate authority
blocks.body: A structurally valid model response cannot grant permissions, choose unrestricted tools, or bypass policy.

blocks.code:
const result = OutputSchema.safeParse(JSON.parse(raw));
if (!result.success) throw new OutputRejectedError();

lessons.title: Bound retries and failure
lessons.summary: Keep recovery within latency, reliability, and cost limits.

blocks.body: Retry only failures likely to recover, use a strict attempt limit, and return an explicit terminal result when the limit is exhausted.

blocks.title: Bounded recovery
blocks.description: A request is validated after each model call and stops after success or the final allowed failure.

lessons.title: Observe without leaking
lessons.summary: Collect useful operational signals without raw sensitive content.

blocks.body: Track latency, attempts, failure category, token use, and terminal outcome. Avoid prompts, raw output, secrets, and retrieved sensitive data by default.

blocks.title: Useful evidence
blocks.body: Operational metadata should answer what failed and where without reproducing learner or model content.
